params.name: rma
params.description: Return only returns whose Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number matches this value.

params.name: return_status
params.description: Return only returns currently in this status (e.g., in_progress, returned, arrived).

params.name: warehouse_id
params.description: Numeric identifier of the warehouse processing the return; use the value returned by the warehouses endpoint.

params.name: return_reason
params.description: Return only returns flagged with this reason code (e.g., damaged, wrong_item, no_longer_needed).

params.name: created_at
params.description: Return only returns created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: updated_at
params.description: Return only returns updated at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: desired_action
params.description: Return only returns whose items have this intended processing action (e.g., damaged_not_resellable, received_back_into_inventory).

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page number to return. Defaults to 1.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results per page (default and maximum values are documented at the endpoint level).

items.docs:
This endpoint simulates the full return lifecycle on Sandbox environment. It can't be used in production!

The return goes through arrival, check-in, receiving, grading, and completion based on the specified completion mode and disposition.

## Completion Modes
Completion mode changes how many units are received of the FIRST item in the return. Other items are always fully received.
| Mode | Description | Constraint |
|------|-------------|------------|
| `fully_received` | Receives the complete
